header.name: Compass Link
header.description: v1.2.0 - Hold a compass to see your coordinates in both dimensions and the biome you are in, for lining up Nether portals.

settings.text: §lCompass Link§r - hold a compass to see where you are. Your current dimension is on top, the other dimension underneath.
§7Changes here take effect the next time the world loads.§r

§7From the Overworld, the Nether biome is worked out from the world seed, so it shows even where nobody has been. From the Nether, the Overworld biome shows only while that part of the Overworld is loaded, for example when another player is there.§r
